title.narrative: Supporting the Artificial Limbs and Rehabilitation Center in Sayun Governorate with artificial limbs and their supplies.

description.narrative: Providing artificial limbs and their supplies in order to benefit the largest number of injured people, reduce the waiting period, and benefit from the operating partner in providing physical rehabilitation services for people with special needs, following up on them and benefiting from them in community service, diagnosis, determining the treatment plan for each individual patient, installing artificial limbs of all kinds, and providing functional rehabilitation service for the limbs. Industrial and their continuous follow-up and raise the capabilities of the medical and technical staff professionally and scientifically and prepare them to deal with specific cases and limit the migration of medical and technical staff specialized in the localization and improvement of prosthetic limb and rehabilitation services and assisting people with special needs by engaging them in social life and maintaining their continued performance within the elements of civil society, And raising the capabilities of workers at the Prosthetics Center with the latest medical sciences
Providing the needs for manufacturing, installation and rehabilitation of (500) beneficiaries

Supporting the Prosthetic Limbs and Rehabilitation Center in Sayun Governorate with prosthetic limbs and their supplies by securing, purchasing, and delivering them to the implementing partner and operator of the centers to install them according to the health condition of each individual beneficiary.
